model.title: Upper Price River Watershed Project Act of 2026
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to transfer certain federal land managed by the Bureau of Land Management to the city of Price, Utah, to support local water management and watershed conservation efforts in the Upper Price River area.
